# Videsaur — https://videsaur.co.in/robots.txt

User-agent: *
Allow: /

# Admin surfaces and the API are not content.
Disallow: /admin
Disallow: /api

# Auth and per-user pages: nothing here is indexable, and every visitor sees
# something different.
Disallow: /login
Disallow: /upload
Disallow: /favorites

# Search result pages are thin duplicates of the category feeds.
Disallow: /*?q=
Disallow: /404

# /feed proxies third-party Reddit RSS content — not our IP, not indexable.
# Blocking all crawlers keeps it out of search indices and AdSense evaluation.
Disallow: /feed

# AdSense evaluation crawler: allow full site access for ad targeting EXCEPT
# /feed, which contains Reddit-syndicated content outside our AdSense policy
# scope. Longest-path rule means Disallow: /feed wins over Allow: /.
User-agent: Mediapartners-Google
Disallow: /feed
Allow: /

# AdsBot-Google audits landing pages linked from ads.
# /feed will never be an ad destination, so exclude it here too.
User-agent: AdsBot-Google
Disallow: /feed
Allow: /

# Sitemap index — generated live from the catalogue, lists one sub-sitemap per
# content type plus the static pages. See server/routes/sitemap.js.
Sitemap: https://videsaur.co.in/sitemap.xml
